title: fix: invitation limits suggest removing people or devices
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Remote access tells owners to remove people or devices when an invitation limit is reached.

## User Impact

User impact: owners are directed to review the actual limit instead of making an unrelated access removal. Existing diagnostic details remain available. No invitation, membership, node, or permission behavior changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The same refusal code covers invitation count and lifetime limits as well as member and device limits. The display cannot infer which resource to remove from that code. It now keeps the explanation broad and preserves the specific, sanitized reason in the existing details disclosure.

## Evidence

- Reproduced through the real packaged Remote access page and invite form on main at bcfa6ca00c18fcc619aa1dbf3de301aceec0cd95. A synthetic owner browser signs the invite request, and the mocked Gateway returns the existing 100-invitation refusal. The old message incorrectly recommends removing people or devices.
- Maintainer validation: all Remote access browser unit files plus the standard canaries passed (585 tests). Three equivalent limit examples were consolidated into one invitation-duration case that verifies the corrected guidance and preserved diagnostic. The final error-mapping run plus canaries passed (541 tests), along with i18n, formatting and diff checks. Production code was unchanged by this cleanup.
- Both full-app flows pass: the invitation refusal retains the email draft and reveals the actual limit in Technical details without another write; the existing member-device scenario still verifies owner-signed removal and responsive presentation.
- Scoped lint, the plugin’s browser TypeScript graph, i18n baseline/verification, formatting and diff checks pass. Current-main reconciliation found no intervening changes to the affected message owner. No broad local test suite or live account change was performed.

### Before

![Before: an invitation limit incorrectly suggests removing people or devices](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/00fb7001-1b29-49d9-8fad-3479a619a299)

### After

![After: Remote access directs the owner to the reported limit](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/825d683d-4a4f-485f-b3c6-c8bd5a9a9207)

Real built app and plugin components, synthetic owner key/email and Gateway responses, emulated 1280 × 1000 desktop viewport. No real invitations or members were changed.

Contributor: @vyctorbrzezowski directed this audit and the user-facing correction.
